Thus, the Adeptus Mechanicus endeavors to maintain this position of absolute knowledge and authority, and a Techpriest who feels that this is threatened will go to any lengths to protect his power, including murder, extortion, kidnapping, sabotage and terrorism. After many decades of service, techpriests may be elevated to the rank of Magos, from where they may begin service in one of the many sub-set Divisions and factions within the Cult. It is the Fabricator-General that is the highest-ranking member of the Adeptus Mechanicus on any given forge world, serving as its de-facto planetary governor. His authority is exceedingly great, and in fact the Fabricator-General of Mars holds a permanent seat among the High Lords of Terra.
